reading.body:
CyrusOne Lewisville DFW2 publishes 12 MW of IT capacity, placing it 12th among 19 Texas facilities with disclosed figures and 2.5 percent of the state's 475 MW announced load.

Texas has 133 mapped data center sites, but most publish no capacity. Among the 19 with figures, this facility sits in the lower half, and its 200,000 square feet of technical space is modest relative to the state's announced supply. The certifications for PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942 point to regulated enterprise workloads rather than frontier AI training.

For AI specifically, 12 MW is small at current scaling rates, roughly 300 racks at 40 kW per rack. The facility's suitability score of 58 and missing announced expansion mean there is no disclosed path to larger AI capacity. Grid headroom in the Dallas, Fort Worth region and any future expansion beyond published specs remain undisclosed, so the data cannot say whether this campus will matter to AI.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
